title: Designing for every inbox
brief:
An issue of Orbit's newsletter, The Orbit Dispatch, made with Orbit's newsletter kit (see CLAUDE.md for its rules).

- Preview text: "What we learned rendering a million emails."
- Heading: "Designing for every inbox"
- Intro: "Notes from a year of making emails that look right everywhere."
- Two stories, one after the other. Each is an image, a title, a sentence and a button:
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/newsletter-hero.png (1200×500 file), alt text "Emails in three inboxes". Title "The guide". Text "Tables, fonts and dark mode: what holds up, and what doesn't.". Button "Read the guide" to https://orbit.dev/blog/every-inbox?utm_source=newsletter.
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-app.png (1200×700 file), alt text "Orbit's email preview". Title "Preview before you send". Text "Orbit now shows each email as the big clients draw it.". Button "Open Orbit" to https://app.orbit.dev/preview?utm_source=newsletter.
- Orbit's header (the logo) and footer (the address, and the unsubscribe link) are the kit's: use them as they are.
